title: Session 6: Son of God

series.title: What does the Quran say about the Bible?

opening_question: The Quran says God "begetteth not nor was begotten" and denies that Jesus is the Son of God. The Bible says the LORD is one, and calls Jesus the Son of God. What does each text actually say, and what does "one" mean in Hebrew?

steps.question: The Quran says God is One, who "begetteth not nor was begotten". What does Moses say about the LORD, and which word does he use for one?

facts.text: One is echad: "properly united that is one". The same word makes husband and wife "one flesh".
The Quran (112) and the Shema (Deuteronomy 6:4) agree that God is one. They differ on whether the one God has a Son.

Echad can describe a unity made of more than one, as in "one flesh". By itself the word does not prove the Trinity; it shows the Shema leaves room for it. Jewish readers also hold to the Shema and read it as one God without a Son.

steps.question: The Quran says "It befitteth not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should take unto Himself a son". What does the LORD say to his king in Psalm 2?

facts.text: Son in Psalm 2:7 is ben; in Psalm 2:12, "Kiss the Son", it is bar, a word Strong's explains as "the heir (apparent to the throne)".
The Quran (4:171) calls Jesus "His word which He conveyed unto Mary, and a spirit from Him". Sale's wording goes on: "say not, There are three Gods".

steps.question: Jesus asked his disciples who they said he was. What did Peter answer, and where did Jesus say that answer came from?

facts.text: Son is huios: a "son". Jesus says Peter's answer came not from "flesh and blood" but from "my Father which is in heaven".

steps.question: At his trial the high priest asked Jesus, "Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?" What did Jesus answer, and what did the high priest do?

facts.text: Blessed is eulogetos: "adorable". Jesus answers "I am", and adds Daniel 7:13: "ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven".
The high priest tore his clothes and called it blasphemy, blasphemia: "vilification (especially against God)".

steps.question: The Quran asks Jesus, "Didst thou say unto mankind: Take me and my mother for two gods beside Allah?" What does John say about the Word, and whom does Jesus name in Matthew 28:19?

facts.text: Word is logos: "something said". John says the Word "was with God, and the Word was God" and "was made flesh". The Quran also calls Jesus God's word (3:45, 4:171), but not God.

Quran 5:116 speaks of Jesus and his mother as "two gods", and 5:73 of God as "the third of three". The three Jesus names are "the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost". Mary is not among them, and the Bible never calls her a god.

steps.question: Living it out: Peter answered "Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God". What do these verses say follows from that confession?

facts.text: "if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved".
